BiblicalUsage: Zophah is a son of Helem, named among the sons of Asher. In 1 Chronicles 7:35, Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh. The fuller story is told on the Zophah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zophah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
